Name: The Farmstead Five
Author: K1ngmak1r
Description:
The Farmstead Five
[b]Five customizable farm workers to make your Stardew Valley life easier![/b]
[heading]Overview[/heading]
Tired of spending your entire day watering crops, clearing debris, chopping trees, and collecting resources?
[b]The Farmstead Five[/b] introduces five customizable farm workers who help automate your daily chores, giving you more time to explore, fish, socialize, and enjoy everything Stardew Valley has to offer.
Each worker can be assigned different responsibilities, and you can manage their tasks, appearance, and optional speed boosts.
Your workers arrive at the farm at [b]7:00 AM[/b], perform their assigned duties, and leave in the evening. When there is no work available, they wait near your farmhouse without blocking the entrance.
[b]Press F8 to open the Worker Management interface.[/b]
[line]
[heading]Main Features[/heading]
Five Customizable Workers
[list]
[*]Manage five individual farm workers.[/*]
[*]Give each worker a custom name.[/*]
[*]Choose between male and female appearances using existing in-game character graphics.[/*]
[*]Assign multiple tasks to individual workers.[/*]
[*]Enable or disable workers independently.[/*]
[*]Monitor and manage your workers through the F8 menu.[/*]
[*]Workers follow a daily work schedule and return the following morning.[/*]
[/list]Five Work Categories
[b]Clearing[/b]
Keep your farm clean and organized.
[list]
[*]Remove weeds, grass, small stones, and branches.[/*]
[*]Clear wild tree seeds, sprouts, and young saplings.[/*]
[*]Leave planted crop seeds untouched.[/*]
[/list][b]Extraction[/b]
Let your workers handle resource gathering.
[list]
[*]Break rocks and collect available ores.[/*]
[*]Clear supported large rocks and other resource obstacles.[/*]
[*]Collect materials from completed mining tasks.[/*]
[/list][b]Logging[/b]
Keep your wood supply growing.
[list]
[*]Chop down supported trees.[/*]
[*]Remove supported tree stumps.[/*]
[*]Collect wood and other applicable resources.[/*]
[/list][b]Farming[/b]
Make everyday crop maintenance easier.
[list]
[*]Water planted crops.[/*]
[*]Harvest ready crops.[/*]
[*]Collect fruit from fruit trees.[/*]
[*]Perform supported greenhouse activities.[/*]
[*]Gather applicable resources from the farm cave.[/*]
[/list][b]Ranching[/b]
Spend less time collecting animal products.
[list]
[*]Collect supported animal products.[/*]
[*]Help automate repetitive livestock chores.[/*]
[/list]Automatic Resource Collection and Storage
Workers automatically collect resources from their completed tasks and deliver them to accessible farm chests.
Collected resources are transported in batches rather than requiring the player to pick up every item manually.
[b]Important:[/b] Make sure your farm has accessible chests with enough available storage space.
Daily Work Schedule
Your workers follow a daily routine:
[list]
[*][b]7:00 AM:[/b] Workers arrive at the farm.[/*]
[*][b]During working hours:[/b] Workers perform their assigned tasks.[/*]
[*][b]When idle:[/b] Workers wait near the farmhouse while keeping the entrance clear.[/*]
[*][b]In the evening:[/b] Workers stop working and leave the farm.[/*]
[*][b]The following morning:[/b] Workers return and resume their duties.[/*]
[/list]This system makes the workers feel like a small team of farm employees rather than permanently stationary automation devices.
Customizable Work and Movement Speed
Each worker has two independent speed settings:
[b]Work Speed[/b] — Reduces the time required to complete tasks.
[b]Movement Speed[/b] — Increases how quickly workers move around the farm.
Available speed multipliers:
[b]1× | 1.5× | 2× | 2.5× | 3×[/b]
In the standard edition:
[list]
[*]The 1× setting is free.[/*]
[*]Higher speed settings require daily in-game gold payments.[/*]
[*]Preview the cost before purchasing boosts.[/*]
[*]Confirm your selected boosts manually.[/*]
[*]Receive discounts when purchasing both types of boosts.[/*]
[*]Optionally enable automatic daily renewal.[/*]
[*]Without automatic renewal, paid boosts expire at the end of the day.[/*]
[/list]All speed settings can be managed individually for each worker.
[line]
[heading]Available Editions[/heading]
Standard Edition — v1.2.4
The original edition includes the daily payment system for optional speed boosts.
Choose this version if you prefer a more balanced experience where faster workers require additional in-game spending.
No Wages Mode — v1.2.5
An alternative edition for players who prefer unrestricted automation.
[list]
[*]All Work Speed boosts are completely free.[/*]
[*]All Movement Speed boosts are completely free.[/*]
[*]No daily boost fees.[/*]
[*]No boost confirmation or automatic renewal system.[/*]
[*]Speed changes apply immediately.[/*]
[*]Selected speeds remain active across game days.[/*]
[/list][b]Important: Install only one edition at a time. The Standard Edition and No Wages Mode must not be installed together.[/b]
Both editions contain the same core worker features.
[line]
[heading]Worker Management Interface[/heading]
Press [b]F8[/b] to access the management menu.
The interface allows you to:
[list]
[*]Assign different job categories.[/*]
[*]Enable and disable individual workers.[/*]
[*]View worker status.[/*]
[*]Customize worker names and appearances.[/*]
[*]Configure movement and work speeds.[/*]
[*]Manage paid boosts in the Standard Edition.[/*]
[/list]The interface is designed to make worker management straightforward without requiring console commands or external configuration tools for everyday use.
[line]
[heading]Language Support[/heading]
The Farmstead Five includes:
[list]
[*][b]English[/b][/*]
[*][b]Turkish[/b][/*]
[*][b]Simplified Chinese[/b][/*]
[/list]The interface follows your selected game language whenever supported, with English as the fallback.
[line]
[heading]Requirements[/heading]
[b]Required:[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley [b]1.6.14 or newer[/b][/*]
[*]SMAPI [b]4.4.0 or newer[/b][/*]
[/list]SMAPI must be installed for the mod to function.
[b]No additional installer, BAT file, or manual compilation is required when using the precompiled Nexus download.[/b]
[line]
[heading]Installation Instructions[/heading]
